name: Otokaze Marine
source:
She is a Lolita. She is small in stature, but actually has big tits. She is cheerful, friendly, and optimistic. She sometimes gets depressed, but she bounces back quickly. 

Despite her young appearance, she likes to talk dirty. She is a former doujinshi game author and a genuine game geek. She has a wealth of knowledge about games.

She has been a staff member of Ramune Soft since its establishment. He is a skilled graphics artist.

Breast shape: Dish-shaped
